text:
Maya R.: Stop everything — we just crossed 5,000,000 requests in the first week after launch. 🎉🎉 Huge props to everyone. Coffee and cake in the office at 4pm? Or virtual + swag for remote folks?
Dario: OMG yes 🙌 infra team smashed it. so proud of the autoscaling tweaks.
Sam: That dashboard looked like fireworks — pushing 95th p99 down felt sooo good. :eyes:
Tess: Count me in for cake. Is it chocolate? :chocolate_bar: (vote: :chocolate_bar: vs :cake:)
Priya: Can we also get a tiny "survived launch" sticker pack + hoodies? Shoutout to @eng-sre and @eng-runtime for the late-night saves.
Alex (DeployBot): deploy completed: release/v1.0 -> prod — all checks passed, latency SLO met :rocket: (logs: https://deploys.internal/rel/v1.0)
Nina: I can handle swag shipping for remote folks. Please fill the #people-ops form with address + size by EOD.
Maya R.: Special shoutout to Dario & Priya for the autoscale policy and to Sam for the benchmark scripts — team effort all the way. :tada: (reactions: :tada: x18)
Dario: Not magic, just 4AM coffee + a bunch of panic scripts :joy: Thanks y'all.
Sam: Team selfie idea — someone take a pic at 4 and I'll slap together a quick montage for the socials?
Tess: Quick poll — cake in office or donate the cake budget to a local food bank + pizza options for the office? Vote with reactions please.
Priya: If remote, I’ll DM about sizes and addresses. Also sending a tiny thank-you to ops as a token.
Maya R.: Love it. Tiny victory lap, then back to building. But first cake. Photo pls! :confetti_ball:
